All three pens have a dark gray/black body and a dark cap-like part at the lower end.
All pens appear to have the same dark color and material.
All three pens show the dark cap-like part at the bottom; no exposed writing tip is visible.
All three pens are aligned vertically and parallel to each other.
The dark cap-like markers are all at the bottom end of the pens.
The carrier moves from left to right initially but stops completely around 00:05 and remains stationary until the end of the video.
The pens remain stable on the carrier plate throughout the video.
